mapper.select: select s.problem_id as problem_id, s.title as title, s.max_score as score, sum(case when r.status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as right_num, sum(case when r.record_id is not null and r.status = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as wrong_num, avg(r.score) as average from contest_problem_snapshot s left join contest_records r on r.problem_id = s.problem_id and r.contest_id = s.contest_id where s.contest_id = #{contestId} group by s.problem_id, s.problem_order, s.title, s.max_score order by s.problem_order, s.problem_id

select uc.user_id as user_id, (select count(*) from contest_records cr where cr.contest_id = #{contestId} and cr.user_id = uc.user_id and cr.status = 1) as correct_num, (select count(*) from contest_records cr where cr.contest_id = #{contestId} and cr.user_id = uc.user_id and cr.status = 0) as wrong_num, (select count(*) from contest_problem_snapshot s where s.contest_id = #{contestId}) - (select count(*) from contest_records cr where cr.contest_id = #{contestId} and cr.user_id = uc.user_id and cr.status in (0, 1)) as absent_num, (select sum(cr.score) from contest_records cr where cr.contest_id = #{contestId} and cr.user_id = uc.user_id) as score, IF(ISNULL(ub.user_id), 0, 1) as submitted, IF(ISNULL(ub.submit_time), 0, ub.submit_time > c.end_time) as late
from user_contest uc left join contest c on c.contest_id = uc.contest_id left join user_submit ub on ub.contest_id = uc.contest_id and ub.user_id = uc.user_id where uc.contest_id = #{contestId}

select s.problem_id as problemId, s.title as title, cr.status as correct, cr.score as score, cr.contest_id from contest_problem_snapshot s left join contest_records cr on s.problem_id = cr.problem_id and s.contest_id = cr.contest_id and cr.user_id = #{userId} where s.contest_id = #{contestId} order by s.problem_order, s.problem_id
